test_cases.title: S_define Wires Dynamics, Sensors, Scenario, and FSW POSIX
test_cases.setup: Open the sim harness Trick S_define source and the parsed Trick sim object listing produced by the harness build.
procedure: Inspect the sim harness S_define and confirm sim_dynamics, sim_sensors, sim_scenario, and FSW POSIX sim objects are declared.
Build the Trick sim and confirm the resulting executable links the FSW POSIX library archives.
Run the sim harness with --help and inspect the printed sim object listing for all four components.
Record the S_define section, the linker map snippet, and the sim object listing as inspection evidence.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: S_define declares sim_dynamics, sim_sensors, sim_scenario, and FSW POSIX sim objects; harness executable links the FSW POSIX archives; sim object listing reports all four components present.

expected_artifacts.description: Signed inspection log of the S_define section showing all four sim modules + FSW POSIX wired

test_cases.title: Trick Scheduler Drives Fixed Time Step Across Components
test_cases.setup: Configure the sim harness with a fixed time step and a fault-free scenario; instrument dynamics, sensors, and FSW with per-step timestamp recorders.
procedure: Run the sim harness for at least 1000 scheduled steps.
Read the recorded sim_time values from each component each step.
Compute the per-step delta between consecutive sim_time samples for each component.
Compare the per-step deltas to the configured time step.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: All components report identical sim_time values each step and the per-step delta equals the configured time step for every step in the run.

test_cases.title: Time-Step Order Is Dynamics, Sensors, Then FSW
test_cases.setup: Instrument the sim harness with a per-step ordering log emitted from dynamics, sensors, and FSW callbacks.
procedure: Run the sim harness for 100 steps with a fault-free scenario.
Read the ordering log emitted each step.
Compare the per-step entries to the expected dynamics, sensors, FSW order.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Every step in the ordering log shows dynamics executed before sensors and sensors executed before FSW with no out-of-order entries.

test_cases.title: Simulated Sensor Sample Reaches FSW POSIX Driver Input
test_cases.setup: Configure sim_sensors to emit a known IMU sample sequence each step; tap the FSW POSIX IMU driver input buffer.
procedure: Run the sim harness for 50 steps with the deterministic IMU sequence.
Read the FSW POSIX IMU driver input buffer contents each step.
Compare each captured sample to the expected sim_sensors output for the same step.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: FSW POSIX IMU driver input buffer contains the exact sim_sensors sample emitted for the same step, with no missing or duplicated samples across the run.

test_cases.title: Sensor-to-FSW Delivery Occurs Every Scheduled Step
test_cases.setup: Instrument the sim harness sensor-to-FSW boundary with a per-step delivery counter for each simulated sensor channel.
procedure: Run the sim harness for at least 500 steps.
Read the per-step delivery counters for each simulated sensor channel.
Compare delivery counts against the scheduled step count.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Each simulated sensor channel reports a delivery count equal to the scheduled step count over the run.

test_cases.title: FSW POSIX Applications Execute In-Process Each Step
test_cases.setup: Instrument the FSW POSIX application entry points (nav, command, telem) to record their PID, TID, and per-step execution count.
procedure: Run the sim harness for 200 steps.
Read the recorded PID, TID, and execution counts for each FSW POSIX application.
Compare PIDs to the harness process PID and execution counts to the scheduled step count.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Each FSW POSIX application records the harness PID, executes once per scheduled step, and accumulates an execution count equal to the scheduled step count.

test_cases.title: Scenario Selection Via Trick Command-Line Argument
test_cases.setup: Provide two distinct scenario configuration files with different initial states and durations.
procedure: Run the sim harness with the first scenario passed via the Trick scenario CLI argument.
Read the loaded scenario identifier and initial state from the run startup log.
Run the sim harness with the second scenario passed via the same CLI argument.
Read the loaded scenario identifier and initial state from the second run startup log.
Compare each loaded scenario identifier and initial state to the corresponding CLI selection.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Each run loads the scenario identifier and initial state matching the scenario named on the Trick command-line argument with no fallback to a default scenario.

test_cases.title: Identical Config and Seed Produce Bit-Identical Outputs
test_cases.setup: Select a fixed scenario configuration and a fixed random seed; designate a clean output directory for each repeat.
procedure: Run the sim harness with the chosen scenario and seed into output directory A.
Run the sim harness again with the same scenario and seed into output directory B.
Compute SHA-256 digests of the SD log, telemetry capture, and truth-vs-FSW comparison files in each directory.
Compare digests across directory A and directory B.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: SHA-256 digests for the SD log, telemetry capture, and truth-vs-FSW comparison are byte-identical between directory A and directory B.

test_cases.title: Different Seed Produces Different Outputs With Same Config
test_cases.setup: Select a fixed scenario configuration; choose two different random seeds; designate clean output directories for each run.
procedure: Run the sim harness with the fixed scenario and the first seed into directory A.
Run the sim harness with the fixed scenario and the second seed into directory B.
Compute SHA-256 digests of the SD log, telemetry capture, and truth-vs-FSW comparison files in each directory.
Compare digests across directory A and directory B.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: SHA-256 digests for the SD log, telemetry capture, and truth-vs-FSW comparison differ between directory A and directory B, confirming seed influences output.

test_cases.title: SD Log Artifact Emitted Each Run
test_cases.setup: Configure the sim harness with a fault-free scenario that exercises FSW SD log writes; designate a clean output directory.
procedure: Run the sim harness to completion.
Read the configured output directory and locate the SD log artifact file.
Open the SD log file and parse its records.
Compare the parsed record count against the expected non-zero count for the scenario.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: SD log artifact file exists in the output directory after the run, is non-empty, parses successfully, and contains the expected non-zero record count.

test_cases.title: Telemetry Capture Artifact Emitted Each Run
test_cases.setup: Configure the sim harness with a scenario that exercises FSW telemetry packet emission; designate a clean output directory.
procedure: Run the sim harness to completion.
Read the configured output directory and locate the telemetry capture artifact file.
Decode the captured telemetry packets and count valid CCSDS packets.
Compare the decoded packet count and contents against the expected scenario telemetry profile.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Telemetry capture file exists in the output directory after the run, decodes into the expected number of valid CCSDS packets, and matches the scenario telemetry profile.

test_cases.title: Truth-vs-FSW Comparison Artifact Contents
test_cases.setup: Configure the sim harness with a scenario that exercises nav state estimation; designate a clean output directory.
procedure: Run the sim harness to completion.
Read the configured output directory and locate the truth-vs-FSW comparison file.
Parse the comparison file and confirm each row contains sim_time, simulated truth nav state, and FSW nav state columns.
Compare the row count against the scheduled step count for the run.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Truth-vs-FSW comparison file exists, contains sim_time, simulated truth nav state, and FSW nav state columns, and has a row count equal to the scheduled step count.

test_cases.title: All Run Artifacts Collected Under Configured Output Directory
test_cases.setup: Choose a non-default output directory path; configure the sim harness to use it via the output directory CLI argument.
procedure: Run the sim harness to completion with the configured output directory argument.
List the contents of the configured output directory.
Inspect the working directory and any other candidate paths for stray artifact files.
Confirm the SD log, telemetry capture, and truth-vs-FSW comparison artifacts are all under the configured directory.
Record the directory listing and the absence of stray files as inspection evidence.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Configured output directory contains the SD log, telemetry capture, and truth-vs-FSW comparison artifacts; no run artifact files are written outside the configured directory.
